newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina collects $341 mln in income, wealth tax.
newsitem.headline: Argentina collects $341 mln in income, wealth tax.

text.p: Argentina collected $236 million in income tax and $105 million in personal wealth levies in 1996, National Tax Service (DGI) head Carlos Silvani said Tuesday.

Silvani told reporters that the figures could not be compared with 1995 data because this year individuals who have a partnership in a company are only due to pay their income and personal wealth tax by May.
"Making a comparison is very difficult," he said.
Last week was the deadline for collection of the two annual taxes.
Despite the change in the deadline for individuals who have a partnership in a company making comparisons difficult, Silvani said he was optimistic tax collection was going well.
"I think we have enough facts to say that things are going well," he told reporters.
He anticipated another 100,000 income tax statements and at least 15 percent more personal wealth statements will have been submitted by the time the May deadline runs out.
